request.description: Creates a new custom profile derived from an existing source template. Supports `sourceProfileName` (e.g. "ATS Recruiter") or `sourceProfileId` (UUID). Automatically clones the source profile's Base Permission Set, Object-Level Security (OLS), Field-Level Security (FLS), System Permissions, and Tab Visibility Settings. Returns the created profile with its `id` for subsequent security configuration.
